# Utah's Moving and Storage

> Utah's Moving and Storage is a family-owned, fully licensed moving company based in Orem, Utah, serving the Wasatch Front. It is rated 4.9 stars across 163+ Google reviews. Founded by Derek Martin, the company offers residential, long-distance, and commercial moving plus professional packing. Local moves start at $140/hour for two movers and a fully equipped truck, with no hidden fees. Utah Motor Carrier license #11735591-0160.

## Key facts

- **Business name:** Utah's Moving and Storage Company
- **Founder/Owner:** Derek Martin
- **Address:** 240 Garden Park, Orem, UT 84057
- **Phone:** (801) 980-0223
- **Email:** utahsmovingandstorage@gmail.com
- **License:** Utah Motor Carrier #11735591-0160
- **Rating:** 4.9 / 5 stars (163+ Google reviews)
- **Hours:** Monday–Saturday, 7am–7pm
- **Service area:** Wasatch Front — Orem, Provo, Salt Lake City, Lehi, Draper, Sandy, West Jordan, Saratoga Springs, Spanish Fork, Park City, plus long-distance moves with one endpoint in Utah.

## Pricing (at a glance)

- **Local moves:** from $140/hour for 2 movers + truck; 3-hour minimum; $40/hour per additional mover. No hidden fees.
- **Labor-only moves:** from $140/hour (you provide the truck) + dispatch fee.
- **Specialty / single-item (pianos, safes, pool tables, exercise equipment):** flat-rate, personalized quote.
- **Long-distance:** personalized quote with set travel costs and no cargo transfers.
- **Commercial / office:** personalized quote, scheduled to minimize downtime.
- **Packing:** full-service or partial, plus supplies (boxes S–XL, bubble wrap, packing foam, specialty boxes).

## Services

- [Residential Moving](https://utahsmovingandstorage.com/services/residential/): Full-service and labor-only local home moves from $140/hour, including blankets, disassembly/reassembly, and a free virtual walkthrough.
- [Long-Distance Moving](https://utahsmovingandstorage.com/services/long-distance/): Interstate moves with set travel costs, no cargo transfers, and one trained crew end to end.
- [Commercial & Office Moving](https://utahsmovingandstorage.com/services/commercial/): Business relocations planned around your hours to minimize downtime.
- [Packing Services & Supplies](https://utahsmovingandstorage.com/services/packing/): Professional packing and quality moving supplies for fragile and high-value items.
- [Pricing](https://utahsmovingandstorage.com/pricing/): Transparent rates with no hidden fees.
